payload.hook: Most creator tools forget everything you told them.
payload.text:
Most creator tools forget everything you told them.

1/ You interview once. You research. You draft. Then the next post starts from zero.

2/ That is the tax nobody prices: every post re-learns who you are.

3/ Foundry keeps one ledger instead. Five bots, one memory. The next draft starts where the last one ended.
